questions.text: Decision devA.DEC-011 (routing_and_places_service) is blocked on a material contradiction: the comparison did not address a material contradiction about Google Maps Platform on pricing and free cap (devA.CLM-696, devA.CLM-697, devA.CLM-698): the sources give Free usage cap: 1,000 events; Cap - 100,000: $20.00 per 1,000 events and Free usage cap: 10,000 events; Cap - 100,000: $5.00 per 1,000 events and Free usage cap: 5,000 events; Cap - 100,000: $17.00 per 1,000 events; the comparison did not address a material contradiction about Google Maps Platform Places API Legacy on pricing and free cap (devA.CLM-984, devA.CLM-985): the sources give free usage cap: 1,000 events; cap - 100,000:. Answer open to leave the decision open (the plan states the conflict and the check that settles it), or a note on which source to trust; the note is recorded with the decision, and the conflict is settled by evidence, never by the note.

Decision devA.DEC-014 (itinerary_storage) is blocked on a material contradiction: the comparison did not address a material contradiction about Databricks Lakebase on database type (devA.CLM-1018): the sources give fully managed Postgres database integrated into the Databricks platform; the comparison did not address a material contradiction about Neon on encryption at rest (devA.CLM-803): the sources give AES-256 encryption at rest across all storage layers. Answer open to leave the decision open (the plan states the conflict and the check that settles it), or a note on which source to trust; the note is recorded with the decision, and the conflict is settled by evidence, never by the note.

Decision devA.DEC-015 (web_hosting) is blocked on a material contradiction: the comparison did not address a material contradiction about Fly Io Fly Io on invoice waiver threshold (devA.CLM-1104, devA.CLM-1124): the sources give under $5 and under $5 waived; the comparison did not address a material contradiction about Vercel on commercial deployment allowance (devA.CLM-646): the sources give personal, non-commercial projects only. Answer open to leave the decision open (the plan states the conflict and the check that settles it), or a note on which source to trust; the note is recorded with the decision, and the conflict is settled by evidence, never by the note.
